data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'n-y-y', meaning intention, purpose, or desire. In Islamic tradition, having a sincere niyyah, or intention, is crucial for every good deed. The name Niyyat carries the meaning “Intention, purpose” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Niyyat usually hope their child will grow to embody intention, purpose and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the importance of intention and sincerity in religious practices.
data.etymology: Niyyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intention, purpose.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niyyat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
